defects.title: Brahmasthan Exact Center Point Obstructed
defects.description: The exact Brahmasthan center point (6000.00, 4500.00) is occupied or intersected by 2 represented spatial object(s): Room 'Central Hall', Room 'Staircase'.
defects.remedy: Ensure the exact plan center point (Brahmasthan core) is left completely free and open. Relocate load-bearing walls, structural columns, pillars, staircases, and enclosed partitions away from the center coordinate.

defects.title: Dwara Sthana Defect: Nanda Combination (BAD)
defects.description: Dwara Sthana door configuration is classified as Nanda (BAD). Traditional attribution: Harm/misfortune to women (traditional claim). Current doors face EAST, SOUTH.
defects.remedy: Rebalance door placements to favor auspicious combinations such as Dhanya (East), Jaya (South), Kanta (East & West), Manorama (South & West), Sumukha (East, South & West), or Vijaya (All 4 cardinal directions).

defects.title: Main Entrance in Inauspicious Direction (North-West (Vayavya / Vayu))
defects.description: The main entrance 'Main Entrance' is positioned in North-West (Vayavya / Vayu). Vastu Shastra guidelines designate North, North-East, East, South of South-East, or West of North-West as positive suitable entrance zones.
defects.remedy: Relocate the primary entrance door towards North, North-East (Ishanya), or East (Indra) to enhance auspicious ingress of prana and prosperity.

defects.title: Kitchen Sub-Optimal Placement (East (Purva / Indra))
defects.description: Kitchen is located in East (Purva / Indra). Recommended preferred directions are SOUTH_EAST.
defects.remedy: Relocate cooking stove towards South-East (Agneya) or North-West (Vayavya).

defects.title: Central Hall Sub-Optimal Placement (Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core))
defects.description: Central Hall is located in Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core). Recommended preferred directions are NORTH_WEST, NORTH, NORTH_EAST, EAST.
defects.remedy: Align living seating towards North or East during conversations.

defects.title: Staircase in Prohibited Zone (Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core))
defects.description: Staircase is located in Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core). Vastu Shastra explicitly states that Staircase must AVOID NORTH_EAST, CENTER, CENTER_BRAHMASTHAN.
defects.remedy: Build staircases clockwise and keep them out of the sacred central Brahmasthan.

defects.title: Store Room Sub-Optimal Placement (South-East (Agneya / Agni))
defects.description: Store Room is located in South-East (Agneya / Agni). Recommended preferred directions are SOUTH, WEST.
defects.remedy: Heavy storage should be positioned in heavier South or West sectors.
